speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma

The elevated white blood cell count and high lactate dehydrogenase, combined with your B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, are highly suggestive of lymphoma. While the abdominal pain could be related to organomegaly, these findings point toward a hematologic malignancy rather than a primary gastrointestinal issue. Have you noticed any other swollen lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin?
